svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: VM V replies to the client. The VM hook on host 1 finds the router in gateway_routes and sends a tunnel with next header 254 and the gateway address. Host 2 delivers it to the named gateway, and the router changes the source to the public address.
